item.text: {"actions":[{"action":"Retry only files without confirmed acceptance","mechanism":"Receipt-backed acceptance survives later network errors; uncertain uploads are reconciled before another upload starts.","implementation":"Show per-file states: uploading, accepted, failed, or checking. Add upload-attempt status lookup; retry confirmed failures only, retaining accepted receipts.","check":"Interrupt responses after server acceptance. Verify reconciliation finds receipts and retry sends no accepted file bytes.","risk":"Unresolved status must stay visibly uncertain, not silently become failed."},{"action":"Restore available attachments after reopening","mechanism":"Short-lived receipt storage restores server-held attachments without retaining file content or relying on an account.","implementation":"Store only opaque receipts with 24-hour expiry. On reopening, resolve them server-side, list available attachments, and explain that unconfirmed files require reselection.","check":"Close after partial acceptance and reopen. Verify accepted attachments return, reselection guidance appears, and browser storage contains no file content.","risk":"Expired or unavailable receipts require explicit explanation; shared-device recovery can expose attachment metadata."},{"action":"Make replacement an explicit attachment decision","mechanism":"Five visible attachment slots distinguish retrying a failure from adding or replacing an attachment.","implementation":"Count accepted, uploading, and uncertain files toward five. Require explicit removal or replacement before admitting another; cancel or reconcile pending attempts first.","check":"With four accepted files and one uncertain upload, attempt a sixth. Verify it is blocked until a slot is resolved.","risk":"Removing an attachment from the list must not imply server deletion."},{"action":"Review once and submit without duplicate cases","mechanism":"Explicit review gates case creation; server-side idempotency makes uncertain submission outcomes recoverable without creating another case.","implementation":"Show the final receipt-backed list and require confirmation. Bind a submission token to that reviewed version; recover its outcome through receipt lookup.","check":"Change the list after review, double-click submit, then disconnect and reopen. Require renewed review and verify only one case exists.","risk":"Attachment or form edits must invalidate review; disable submission while uploads remain unresolved."}],"abstention_reason":""}
